remarks: Welcome to your new home! Light, spacious 2 BR/2.5 bath townhouse, 1000+ sq. ft., move-in ready, in excellently maintained Norwalk complex with very low common charges! Close to buzzing South Norwalk (SONO) and a commuter's dream- steps away from train station with express access to NYC, and quick access to the Merritt Parkway and I-95. Freshly painted with hardwood floors and new windows throughout. Open floor plan LR/DR, kitchen with backsplash and excellent cabinet space. Upper level holds 2 spacious BRs (fit king beds) with deep closets & ceiling fans. Washer/dryer adds to easy living. One designated parking spot and lots of visitor parking. Ideal for small family or roommates. Beautifully maintained walkways and common green space for relaxing. ONE DOG OR ONE CAT ALLOWED. PLEASE PARK IN RESERVED SPACE # 45
